Vendored, unmodified builds:

- d3-array 3.2.4 and d3-geo 3.1.1, ISC licence, Mike Bostock (https://d3js.org)
- topojson-client 3.1.0, ISC licence, Mike Bostock
- nordic.json: Finland (10m) and its neighbours (50m) from the same world-atlas data, clipped to northern Europe.
- world-110m.json: world-atlas 2.0.2 countries-110m (ISC), properties removed to save space. Boundaries from Natural Earth, public domain.
